items.label: Record Watch
items.message: Mudassir has broken the all-time LSL regular-season goal record. His Week 6 hat trick in a 5-4 loss to Sharp Strikers pushed his career regular-season total to 19 goals in 11 games, passing Muzamil Kharooti's 18 and the retired Hafizullah's 13.

items.label: Week 6 Recap
items.message: Week 6 is posted: Sharp Strikers beat Leeward Lions 5-4 (Mudassir 3 and Muhummud Teli 1 for Leeward; M Yahya 3 and Rehan Mohammed 2 for Sharp), Amax Visionaries beat Memon Mavericks 4-2 (Adil Mubashir 3 and Uzair Sidat 1 for Amax; Hasan Hamraz and Nasibullah Barak each scored for Memon), EM Haulers FC beat Gangat Warriors 4-3 (Haroon Ahmadi 3 and Tayyib Mohammed 1 for EM; Taaha Nakhuda scored all three Gangat goals), and Rawaha Royals beat Refuel Rovers 2-0 on two goals from Mohammad Ibrahim.

items.label: Week 5 Recap
items.message: Week 5 is posted: Rawaha Royals beat Amax Visionaries 4-1, Refuel Rovers beat Gangat Warriors 1-0 on a Mosa Fazli goal, Leeward Lions beat EM Haulers FC 1-0 before a late abandoned finish, and Sharp Strikers beat Memon Mavericks 1-0 on a Mohammed Rayyan Syed goal.

items.label: Inter-Madrasah Team
items.message: Lantern finalized its 2026 Inter-Madrasah Team after a player meeting on Saturday, June 27. Ashique is coaching, Moulana Junaid is team owner, and the one-day tournament is set for July 5, 2026. Final adjustments are still expected before tournament day.

items.label: Week 4 Results
items.message: Leeward Lions defeated Memon Mavericks 8-2 behind 5 goals from Mudassir, 2 from Ajmal Chakkari, and 1 from Abu Bakr Manjra. Nasibullah Barak scored both Memon goals. Sharp Strikers beat Rawaha Royals 4-3, EM Haulers FC beat Refuel Rovers 2-1, and Amax Visionaries defeated Gangat Warriors 2-0.

items.label: Week 4 Schedule
items.message: Saturday, July 4 at Grenoble P.S. Field: Memon Mavericks face Leeward Lions at 9:15 AM, Sharp Strikers face Rawaha Royals at 10:00 AM, Refuel Rovers face EM Haulers FC at 10:45 AM, and Amax Visionaries face Gangat Warriors at 11:30 AM. Juniors skills, dribbling, and scrimmage run from 12:15 PM to 1:15 PM.

items.label: Week 3 Recap
items.message: Week 3 was a statement week in the LSL Seniors League: Sharp Strikers, Leeward Lions, and EM Haulers FC each scored six, Refuel Rovers kept a 5-0 clean sheet, and M Yahya plus Muzamil Kharooti both scored four goals.

items.label: Week 3 Result
items.message: Sharp Strikers opened Week 3 with a 6-1 win over Gangat Warriors. M Yahya scored 4, Rehan Mohammed scored 2, and Taaha Nakhuda scored for Gangat.

items.label: Week 3 Result
items.message: EM Haulers FC defeated Rawaha Royals 6-1 in Week 3. Muzamil Kharooti scored 4, Haroon Ahmadi scored 2 with 1 assist, and Mohammad Ibrahim scored for Rawaha.

items.label: Week 3 Result
items.message: Refuel Rovers defeated Memon Mavericks 5-0 in Week 3. Mosa Fazli scored 3, Abdul Ghiyas Solyman added 2 assists, Hasibullah Kharooti scored 1, Ishaaq Ali scored 1, and Refuel kept a clean sheet.

items.label: Week 3 Result
items.message: Leeward Lions defeated Amax Visionaries 6-1 in Week 3. Mudassir scored 3, Ajmal Chakkari scored 3, Adil Mubashir scored for Amax, and Muhummud Teli assisted an Ajmal goal.

items.label: League Reminder
items.message: Parents and spectators must stay off the grass during games. Concerns should go through the player's coach, handshakes are mandatory after every game, and the official rule book will be available at the desk.

items.label: Week 3 Schedule
items.message: Saturday, June 27 at Grenoble P.S. Field: Gangat Warriors face Sharp Strikers at 9:15 AM, Refuel Rovers face Memon Mavericks at 10:00 AM, Leeward Lions face Amax Visionaries at 10:45 AM, and EM Haulers FC face Rawaha Royals at 11:30 AM. Juniors skills, dribbling, and scrimmage run from 12:15 PM to 1:15 PM.

items.label: Week 2 Recap
items.message: EM Haulers FC stayed perfect, Leeward Lions climbed three places, Rawaha Royals completed a 3-2 comeback, and Refuel Rovers earned their first win of 2026.

items.label: Postgame Discussion
items.message: EM Haulers FC defeated Sharp Strikers 3-2 behind a Haroon Ahmadi hat trick. Uwais Bemat, normally a field player, was forced into goal and saved Marwan Ahmed's penalty. Reports from the field also described strong disagreement over several refereeing decisions.

items.label: Current Playoff Picture
items.message: If the playoffs started after Week 5, Leeward Lions and EM Haulers FC would receive semifinal byes. Sharp Strikers and Refuel Rovers would sit in the quarterfinal paths, with Rawaha Royals, Gangat Warriors, and Amax Visionaries still fighting around the line. The bracket is current only and not official.

items.label: Trade Roundup
items.message: Two official trades reshape four teams before Week 2: Amax receive Adil Mubashir, Sharp receive Jamal Mujaddidi, Refuel receive Abdul Ghiyas Solyman, and EM receive Mohammed Wahedi.

items.label: Official Trade
items.message: Amax Visionaries receive Adil Mubashir while Sharp Strikers receive Jamal Mujaddidi.

items.label: Official Trade
items.message: Refuel Rovers receive Abdul Ghiyas Solyman while EM Haulers FC receive Mohammed Wahedi.

items.label: Week 2 Schedule
items.message: Saturday, June 20: Refuel Rovers face Amax Visionaries, Gangat Warriors face Leeward Lions, Memon Mavericks face Rawaha Royals, and EM Haulers FC face Sharp Strikers. Seniors begin at 9:15 AM, followed by Juniors skills, dribbling, and scrimmage at 12:15 PM.

items.label: Player Spotlight
items.message: Haroon Ahmadi scored four goals in his first game with EM Haulers FC, leading the 2026 scoring race after the 9-4 win over Amax Visionaries.

items.label: Team Statement
items.message: Sharp Strikers opened the 2026 season with a 5-1 win over Refuel Rovers, while Ishaaq Ali was forced to play goalie for Refuel.

items.label: Coach Watch
items.message: Coach Abdul Hakeem started his new Gangat Warriors chapter with a 1-0 win after winning the 2025 championship with Umer Memon F.C.

items.label: Record Watch
items.message: Muzamil Kharooti has tied Hafizullah's regular-season all-time goal mark at 13 after scoring twice in EM Haulers FC's 9-4 win over Amax Visionaries.

items.label: Trade Watch
items.message: Abdul Ghiyas Solyman's trade market is expanding. Amax Visionaries, Gangat Warriors, and Leeward Lions are now being mentioned, while sources say Abdul would still rather stay with EM Haulers FC.
items.source: Unofficial insider rumor / not confirmed by LSL

items.label: Week 1 Result
items.message: Sharp Strikers defeated Refuel Rovers 5-1. Ishaaq Ali, normally a defender, was forced to play goalie for Refuel Rovers. Scorer details are coming soon.

items.label: Retirement
items.message: Hafizullah has retired at 17 after one of LSL's best scoring careers, finishing with 14 goals, 14 points, 13 games, and the #1 regular-season goals mark.

items.label: Trade Watch
items.message: Abdul Ghiyas Solyman trade talk is heating up after he posted 2 goals and 1 assist in EM Haulers FC's 9-4 win. Insiders now believe the rumor could grow into a multi-player deal, while Muzamil Kharooti and Uwais Bemat are expected to stay for now.
items.source: Unofficial insider rumor / not confirmed by LSL

items.label: Week 1 Result
items.message: Gangat Warriors defeated Memon Mavericks 1-0. Taaha Nakhuda scored the winning goal on a penalty kick.

items.label: Week 1 Results
items.message: Finals posted: Rawaha Royals tied Leeward Lions 1-1, Gangat Warriors defeated Memon Mavericks 1-0, EM Haulers FC defeated Amax Visionaries 9-4, and Sharp Strikers defeated Refuel Rovers 5-1. Haroon Ahmadi scored 4, Abdul Ghiyas Solyman scored 2 with 1 assist, Muzamil Kharooti scored 2, and Uwais Bemat scored 1 for EM Haulers FC.

items.label: Opening Day
items.message: Saturday, June 13, 2026: players should arrive 20 minutes early, games start exactly on time, only indoor cleats are allowed, players should bring water, and light rain may still continue unless a morning update says otherwise.

items.label: Week 1 Schedule
items.message: Saturday, June 13: Sharp Strikers faced Refuel Rovers, EM Haulers FC faced Amax Visionaries, Memon Mavericks faced Gangat Warriors, and Rawaha Royals faced Leeward Lions. Juniors skills, dribbling, and scrimmage followed from 12:15 PM to 1:15 PM.

items.message: The latest 2026 team rosters are posted across the site, including the updated Projection page roster dropdowns.
